name: question-scoped-to-coordinators
body: The `question` tool is allowed only for coordinators and agent-builder. Every other subagent (spec-writer, plan-writer, spec-review, plan-review, implementer, implementation-phase-reviewer) loses `question: allow` and instead routes questions through the coordinator (report back to the coordinator with the question). Agent-builder keeps `question` (its scaffold interview is a sanctioned user interaction, reworded to interview via the coordinator).
